==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a family celebration. We are all eating breakfast food. There is laughter in the air.

I can feel my physical body in the waking world. My entire body is going numb. I am starting to enter sleep paralysis.

I have an out of body experience. I try to trigger my UFO detector with my astral body. When I wake up, I can see that my attempt to trigger the detector failed.
